department: Bioscience PhD Programs (Molecular Biology PhD and Biological Chemistry PhD)

deadline.value: December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027. International applicants outside the U.S. are not being considered for Fall 2027; only those already in the U.S. with valid nonimmigrant status.
deadline.quote: Applications for Fall 2027 are due December 1, 2026.

also.quote: will limit the consideration of international student applications to only those individuals currently in the United States holding valid nonimmigrant status.

app_fee.quote: The application fee for the Molecular Biology PHD or Biological Chemistry PHD is $55 for domestic applicants and $65 for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: The waiver code is for domestic applicants; international applicants cannot get one.
fee_waiver.quote: Faculty and departments are not able to provide or sponsor application fee waivers for international students.

also.quote: International applicant fee waiver is not available

gre_general.value: The GRE is neither required nor accepted.
gre_general.quote: The GRE will no longer be required or accepted.

gre_subject.value: The GRE, including subject tests, is neither required nor accepted.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE will no longer be required or accepted.

supervisor.value: Students choose a thesis advisor by mutual agreement at the end of the first year, after lab rotations.
supervisor.quote: At the end of their first year of graduate school students will choose thesis advisors

funding.value: All accepted students receive a living stipend (USD 39,253 in 2026-27), health insurance and full tuition coverage, regardless of citizenship.
funding.quote: This financial support is for all accepted students, regardless of citizenship.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree with at least a 3.0 GPA is the stated requirement; no master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: applicants must have a bachelor's degree from a regionally-accredited U.S. college or university or equivalent

notes: International applicants outside the U.S. are not being considered for Fall 2027; only those already in the U.S. with valid nonimmigrant status. Applicants may apply to only one of the two programs.
